title: Community Guidelines Update
content: We have officially released the new Community Rules for Uploading a Book to ensure higher quality contributions and a better reading experience.

title: Version 2.0 Launch
content: Kwiddle 2.0 is now live with improved PNG rendering for title pages, an optimized database backend, and 40% faster load times.

title: Security Patch v2.0.1
content: Resolved a critical issue regarding image upload validation and sanitized input fields to prevent XSS attacks.

title: New Support Form
content: You can now request custom title pages directly through our new streamlined support form located in the footer.
